title: Run the platform API and worker locally
caption: From an empty machine to a healthy API on :3100 and worker on :3101 (development only).

steps.title: Install the native services
steps.body: Node 24 (`nvm install` reads `.nvmrc`), pnpm, PostgreSQL 16, Redis 7, Mailpit, optionally the Stripe CLI. Then run `deploy/scripts/dev-setup.sh` (roles and the `velexis` database) and `pnpm install` at the repository root.
steps.expect: `psql` connects as `velexis_platform_app`; `redis-cli ping` answers PONG; Mailpit UI on http://127.0.0.1:8025.

steps.title: Create keys and the env file
steps.body: `pnpm dev:keys` (master key, API key pepper, JWT keys in `.local/keys/`), then `cp platform/backend/.env.example platform/backend/.env.local`.
steps.expect: The process refuses to start on a missing or invalid variable and names it (`config.invalid`).

steps.title: Migrate and load reference data
steps.body: `pnpm db:migrate` (platform and reference migrations as `velexis_migrator`), then `pnpm db:seed:reference`.
steps.expect: `select id, status from platform.schema_migrations order by id;` lists 0001-0004 applied.

steps.title: Start the Amadeus stub and seed
steps.body: In its own terminal `pnpm stub:amadeus`; then `pnpm --filter @velexis/platform-backend dev:seed`.
steps.expect: Prints the password and the `otpauth://` URI of `admin@example.com` once (development only; add the URI to an authenticator). Creates the active test Amadeus account and offices DEV1A0001-DEV1A0040. Exit 0.

steps.title: Start API and worker
steps.body: `pnpm --filter @velexis/platform-backend dev` (build, `tsc --watch`, `node --watch` on dist/main.js and dist/worker.js). For provisioning also run the OTA worker: `pnpm --filter @velexis/ota-backend dev`.

steps.title: Check health
steps.expect: `{"status":"ok"}`; readiness lists `postgres` and `redis` as `ok` (worker also reports its queues). `503` with `unavailable` names the dependency that is down.
